title: UPSSSC Exam Calendar 2026
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
vacancyDetails: Exam calendar listing tentative exam dates for UPSSSC recruitments in 2026
documentsRequired: N/A for calendar; registration credentials when applying for exams
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsssc.gov.in
2. Open Notices / Exam Calendar
3. Download Exam Calendar 2026 PDF
4. Note tentative dates for your applied posts
shortDescription: UPSSSC Exam Calendar 2026 released. Check tentative exam dates at upsssc.gov.in.
content:
UPSSSC has published the Exam Calendar 2026 with tentative schedules for various group examinations.

Candidates should treat dates as tentative and follow individual advertisements for final exam city and admit card notices.
